eis_role: same-cell retrospective diagnostic; April EIS is not used to fit earlier March drive-cycle holdouts
resampling_current: preserve charge over each interval; voltage/temperature interpolated on time only
model_selection_rule: lowest Cycle_1 voltage RMSE; report both; never use held-out drive-cycle outcomes for selection
state_estimator_noise_policy: tune voltage residual scale on Cycle_1, then freeze for all holdouts
threshold_origin: task-specific engineering screening targets, not teacher requirements or product certification
soc_reference_boundary: reference derived from recorded current/Ah and calibration capacity; not independent absolute SOC measurement
optimization_boundary: new protocols evaluated in calibrated simulation only; no claim of measured fast-charge or lifetime gains
